notes.title: Demo Update 0.5.7 released
notes.content: [h2][b]# 🔧 Nion Forge - Patch 0.5.7[/b][/h2][p]---[/p][p]A bit later this time, but here are the patch notes. [/p][p]We actually want to slow down demo updates and fully focus on new content. Still, we’ve made a few more adjustments.[/p][p][/p][h3]## 🚀 New Features[/h3][p]- When ships are particularly long, the camera now adjusts to keep the whole ship in view.[/p][p]- Weight Modulators now increase the effectiveness of direction engines on larger ships.[/p][p]- The stats panel now shows how many enemies and bosses were defeated during a run.[/p][p]---[/p][p][/p][h3]## ⚖️ Balance Changes[/h3][p]- The impact of direction engines in combination with larger ships has been increased.[/p][p]---[/p][p][/p][h3]## 🐞 Bug Fixes[/h3][p]- Fixed several issues with spheres updates. Big Photon Spheres are playable again.[/p][p]- The “Infernal Zone” upgrade of the “Infernal Sphere” could heal the player without “Rising Force” – this is now fixed.[/p][p]- Various text adjustments and minor fixes.[/p][p]- Floating text images now fade out together with their text.[/p][p]---[/p][p][/p][h3]## 🎨 Visual & Audio[/h3][p]- Since most pickups are particle-based, FPS dropped quickly when too many orbs were active at once. Orbs now use a form of LOD and turn into simpler objects when far away from the player.[/p][p]- Enemy and district shaders were reworked to improve foreground/background separation. Lighting was also slightly adjusted in the process.[/p][p]---[/p][p][/p][h3]## 🧩 Misc[/h3][p]- The entire enemy spawn system has been completely reworked.[/p][p]---[/p][p][/p][h3]## 💬 Community[/h3][p]- A huge thank you to all our playtesters!  [/p][p]  Most of these changes were made possible thanks to your feedback and bug reports.  [/p][p]  Keep them coming – they really help us shape Nion Forge into a better game![/p]

tags.feature: - When ships are particularly long, the camera now adjusts to keep the whole ship in view.
- Weight Modulators now increase the effectiveness of direction engines on larger ships.
- The stats panel now shows how many enemies and bosses were defeated during a run.

tags.balance_change: - The impact of direction engines in combination with larger ships has been increased.

tags.bug: - Fixed several issues with spheres updates. Big Photon Spheres are playable again.
- The “Infernal Zone” upgrade of the “Infernal Sphere” could heal the player without “Rising Force” – this is now fixed.
- Various text adjustments and minor fixes.
- Floating text images now fade out together with their text.

tags.feature: - Since most pickups are particle-based, FPS dropped quickly when too many orbs were active at once. Orbs now use a form of LOD and turn into simpler objects when far away from the player.
- Enemy and district shaders were reworked to improve foreground/background separation. Lighting was also slightly adjusted in the process.
- The entire enemy spawn system has been completely reworked.

notes.title: Demo Update 0.5.6 released
notes.content:
# 🔧 Nion Forge – Patch 0.5.6
---

## 🚀 New Features
- New modules:  
  -> Straight connector used as a spacer; very lightweight, requires no NION, and has no additional abilities.  
  -> Magnet Module: increases pickup range; can be attached to the rear of the ship.  
  -> Bullet Connector: connector with 4 attachment points and a bullet shooter that rotates towards enemies.  
  -> Vital Connector: connector with 4 attachment points; grants 3 health and a unique new upgrade that restores health on level up.  
- Connectors on ships now increase pickup range.  
- Game Scene: The timer is now disabled during boss phases.  
- Adjusted the *Rising Force* upgrade for the Laser Cockpit ability — the spawned burning field now also regenerates player health.  
- Rocket Cockpit ability now grants brief invulnerability to the player.  
- Game Scene: Invulnerability now changes the cockpit glass color.  
- Game Scene: Boss 2 reworked.  
  -> Fixed several issues; reworked 3rd boss phase.  
- Game Scene: Boss 4 reworked.  
  -> Added a new second phase; phase 1 and 3 are now more varied. Boss no longer only rotates in one direction for most attacks.  
  -> Reworked boss drop bombs: new sounds; drop bombs deal damage; drop bomb debuff duration reduced from 10s to 6s; player only receives the debuff if vulnerable.  
- Game Scene: Improved reroll mechanic — rerolls now attempt to roll new upgrades instead of duplicating existing ones.  
- Player Hub: Added two new Library entries for *Health & Protection* and for the timer.  
---

## ⚖️ Balance Changes
- Game Scene: Boss health now scales slightly with the number of equipped Main Weapon Modules: `50 HP * BossIndex * WeaponModuleCount`.  
- Game Scene: Time Orbs now generally grant more time when collected.  
- Game Scene: Increased chance for regeneration orbs in green supply boxes in district 3 and 4.  
- Game Scene: Player gains brief invulnerability when returning from the boss dimension or after a level up.  
- Game Scene: Player is invulnerable for a slightly longer duration after taking damage.  
- Game Scene: Shock Nova now knocks enemies back more strongly and deals slightly more damage; small and large nova values have been adjusted accordingly.  
- Adjusted several base stats of modules to differentiate them more clearly.  
- Laser Cockpit ability is now size-limited and can no longer grow indefinitely.  
---

## 🐞 Bug Fixes
- Main Menu: Games can now be restarted after deleting a load box. The trash icon now also disappears correctly.  
- Game Scene: Occasionally, the count of stationary enemies was not updated correctly, preventing them from spawning in a wave.  
- Game Scene: Advanced cockpit abilities are no longer rolled if the base ability has not been leveled yet.  
- Game Scene: Subquest kill boxes in combination with the *Orb Jackpot* upgrade previously tripled loot.  
- Black Marked: Module storage count now displays correctly when loading the shop.  
- Hangar: NION panel disappeared when total NION exceeded 25; it now changes into a text display instead.  
- Fixed some text problems.
---

## 🎨 Visual & Audio
- Game Scene: Subquest texts for supply boxes now indicate their respective color.  
- Game Scene: Upgrade menu now provides clearer explanations for class upgrades.  
- Game Scene: Scatter projectiles from bullet main weapons are now larger and more visible.  
- Game Scene: Floating texts on bosses are displayed for longer.  
- Game Scene: Some districts have been rotated and realigned; after defeating bosses, the light paths now a continuous route.  
- Game Scene: Slight lighting adjustments in district 4.  
- Game Scene: Boss 2 and 4: added some new sound effects.  
- Black Marked: Weapon modules now show their respective projectiles on their cards.  
- Hangar: Connector icons now better match their shapes.  
- Reworked and adjusted models for different wing types.  
- Optimized all existing thruster and connector modules.
---

## 🧩 Misc
- EXP Magnet now triggers a player message.  
- Several description texts revised and updated.  
- Head Cannon logic is now significantly more efficient.  
---

notes.content:
# 🔧 Nion Forge – Patch 0.5.4 (In Development)
---

## 🚀 New Features
- Gamepad/Keyboard icons now correctly update based on the current input device
- Input scheme selection added to the Settings menu in the Main Menu
- UI animations added to the Main Menu and Player Hub
- Main Menu: Back button added to the Load panel
---

## ⚖️ Balance Changes
- Increased the hitbox size of Mosquito enemies
- Explosions from Mosquitos and Boss 1 now deal damage to the entire ship – previously only the cockpit was affected
---

## 🐞 Bug Fixes
- Hangar: Navigation panel in the tutorial now correctly hides to avoid losing button focus
- Hangar: The Startsphere could no longer be selected after canceling cockpit construction
- Hangar: Fixed timing issue when switching presets – the new ship was already loaded before the preset was changed
- Hangar: Hovering a buildable module with the mouse could break focus on the ship, blocking navigation with gamepad or keyboard
- Hangar: The select sound no longer plays if a module has just been built
- GameScene: If you confirmed too early during the Upgrade screen load, you could end up unable to choose an upgrade afterward
- GameScene: Stats menu can no longer be opened via hotkey on the Victory screen after finishing the tutorial
- GameScene: Fixed a tutorial display bug – progress bar max value reduced from 6 to 5
- GameScene: Stats window – changed unit from "TJ" to "TN" for force values
- GameScene: Settings – "Floating Text Toggle" can now be navigated via keyboard
- GameScene: Material switching now works correctly on side Direction Engines
- Main Menu: After deleting a save file, focus is now correctly returned to the deleted loadbox
- Main Menu: Fixed a bug that could cause the entire main menu UI to disappear
- Main Menu: Discord button is no longer clickable when not visible
- Main Menu: Various sound fixes
---

## 🎨 Visual & Audio
- Main Menu: New sprites for the Back button
- GameScene: New sound effect when protection absorbs damage
---

## 🧩 Misc
- Main Menu: Remembers which tab was last open and returns to it when reopening the menu
- Main Menu: Save files can now only be deleted via keyboard or gamepad to prevent accidental deletion by mouse
- Main Menu: Loadbox hover now has a distinct visual style from the selected state
---

# 🔧 Nion Forge – Patch 0.5.1 (In Development)

## 🚀 New Features
- Improved fullscreen settings: clearer distinction between *Windowed* and *Exclusive Fullscreen*.  
  → *Windowed* adapts the game to your monitor resolution.  
  → *Fullscreen* changes your monitor resolution to match the game's.
- Shop buy button is now mouse-compatible.
- Tooltips added to upgrade icons in both Hangar and Stats Menu.
- New system to highlight enemies approaching from behind when using the follow camera.
- New sound effect when protection is fully recharged.

## ⚖️ Balance Changes
- Shield Cockpit now grants +1 Protection.
- Boss 1: Phase 1 firing rate slowed from 0.9s to 1.3s.

- Wall collision in tutorial can no longer trigger infinitely.
- Corrected controller button labels.
- Inverted zoom direction in Shop and Upgrade menu.
- Swapped L1/R1 (Zoom) and L2/R2 (Preset Selection) in Hangar.
- Renamed "Fire Rate" to "Fire Delay" in both Stats Menu and Hangar.

## 🎨 Visual & Audio
- New Nion icon in the Hangar and updated tooltip in the Nion bar.
- When Nion count exceeds 25, icons are replaced with text to avoid UI overlap.
- Stats Menu renamed, current level is now shown, color adjustments made.
- Boost flame size slightly increased.

## 🧩 Misc
- Victory screen texts updated.
- Cursor is now hidden during gameplay.
- "Empty Slot" label added to Load Game boxes.
- All Shop meshes are now aligned upwards.

notes.title: First Demo playable NOW! Demo preparations
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3753650/Nion_Forge_Demo/]Try out the Demo here[/url]

It's getting exciting on the planet Nion Prime!

As you read this, our first demo is ready to be tested. We've been working towards this moment for two years and are now ready for your first impressions as a player!

But we don't just want to tell you about the released demo, we also want to share our latest progress in development.

[h2]Tutorial

Capsules

Small improvements

Ready. Demo. Go![/h2]

[h1]Tutorial[/h1]

Our main focus over the past few months has been on the tutorial, which is also a story intro for the game.

It will be very exciting to see how it is received by players. If the tutorial fails to pick up the player, we will have to adapt it until everything is clear. It's a kind of test run of a district, so the basic elements are introduced so that you don't have to ask yourself later “what's that circle in front there for and can I fly into it, etc.”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996113/4c7fa62ad337ffa0b490f018b7c72ec226552178.jpg[/img]

[h1]Capsules[/h1]

No, not food supplements, in this case capsules are a fancy term for graphics that are displayed in the Steam store and library. These are often the first point of contact with a potential new player so it was important to focus on them. The previous capsules were also crude and we have also redesigned the logo to make it more concise and easier to read in small graphics.

Previously:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996113/8c751a93b9d9817a376ebec31b3976ebf115ce40.png[/img]

Now:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996113/d19bef4849cfc3795df8a7fdad8e8d126efe2112.jpg[/img]

[h1]Small improvements[/h1]

We have adjusted the color of the fog in the city districts a little, depending on the district, so that it looks a little more homogeneous. This also gives us the advantage that we can do a bit more in terms of color in later districts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996113/6fbc9536110c4360a70e44709d9efd0aaac988e6.jpg[/img]

The user interface has also been refined a little. Applied effects that affect the player are now additionally displayed with icons and we have made a few adjustments to menu panels to improve the overall look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996113/be39c1de15551856428cb554e70013f387589a66.jpg[/img]

The hangar user interface still needs to be reworked, there was no time for that before the demo - but we can use the feedback all the more to make it as user-friendly as possible.

Martin has of course optimized a lot of things under the hood, including the third boss, which used to be a bit too easy. Now it has become a real challenge for new players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996113/19a735a9a17896f9f93f2780eecd9c3646e036e2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Ready. Demo. Go![/h1]

Much of our free time has gone into preparing the demo and we hope that you will have a lot of fun with it, including experimenting with different ship configurations and upgrade paths.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3753650/Nion_Forge_Demo/]Try out the Demo here[/url]

In the demo we have included a feedback window which you can activate by pressing F1, ideal for bug reports or suggestions for improvement.

Thank you so much for your patience. We know it’s been a long time without any news, but also: We are just two people who are sacrificing their free time for this, while having a blast of course, but it’s also very exhausting at times.

As before, we also invite you to join the Nion Forge Discord to give us feedback and exchange ideas with other players.

[url=https://discord.gg/yKRZcNMhUC]https://discord.gg/yKRZcNMhUC[/url]

Thanks for all your support, it means everything to us!

[i]Richard and Martin[/i]

notes.title: Nion Forge Devlog March 2025
notes.content:
[h2]Overview[/h2]

We are still working very hard on the game and things are ramping up.

Since we haven’t done one for a long time (and this one being the first on Steam) this is a big update which can be split up into the following chapters:

[h3]Improved enemy ship models

Gamepad everything!

Menu and Ingame HUD Overhaul

Dissolving ships

Optimizations

Upcoming Demo in May![/h3]


[h2]Improved enemy ship models[/h2]

From October until End of December I worked full-time in the game industry as a 3D generalist, and now I can take full use of what I have learned. Byebye low-poly spaceships, hello smooth shading!

Enemy ship “Reaper”, new version compared to old version:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996113/b410bbef23510c98be45c0cc54a3c81590b055c5.jpg[/img]

Enemy ship “Brute”, new version compared to old version:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996113/76e51110b6cca07f09683fe70ce78eb900c6951e.jpg[/img]

Enemy ship “Moth”, new version compared to old version:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996113/feb6e72fe4fb7350001ac0c539c9ef556ec9f4af.jpg[/img]

For every enemy ship we have implemented LODs, so the game doesn’t render detailled ships far away, when it’s not necessary to do so.

LOD0 is referred to as the original (highest quality model) and LOD1 a lower detailled one. For this purpose we did not need to have more than LOD0 and LOD1, but you can of course have also LOD2 and 3 and so on in a game engine.

[h2]Gamepad everything![/h2]

For some time we had a second programmer “WildRikku” who really helped us out and worked very hard on gamepad functionality for the Ship Hangar and game menus as well as general game logic. Gamepad functionality is now fully implemented.

[h2]Menu and Ingame HUD Overhaul[/h2]

During February we reworked the Main Menu two times (it’s now completely dynamic and shows an ingame city).

First, at the start of February we just had our old background swapped with a new one, in preparation for a new build for another convention “Kokoro-Kon” that happened in February:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996113/378e24e83343bad675fffaf3ea5786082dd13e12.jpg[/img]

Recently we decided to make the menu background fully dynamic:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996113/04059a77e235fa9e6940758b02ac63512bcc9ffe.gif[/img]

We also reworked the Ingame HUD (the old one was from the very beginning when Nion Forge was in its game jam infancy).

Before:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996113/9a7ed12183a56d538f9726518bb7bdba4a2376fe.gif[/img]

After:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996113/91a01d4d4dd4bdd73e44fa1b7c8b843800f9d736.gif[/img]

As you can see the minimap is much bigger, an often requested feature change, and the HUD looks more modern and elegant. Of course GIFs are not ideal to show this in detail, but just to have a general idea what to expect.

[h2]Dissolving ships[/h2]

Enemies and all ship modules of the player ship have a dissolve effect implemented now, for when death strikes or a laser from the player hits:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996113/500a4911b4d8505dedcd488b4b3d29429c2f40cc.gif[/img]

In the game engine (Unity) it looks like this. This is a preview, so the weird visual artifacts are not in the actual game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996113/1ba10fd780599038a900feba528081b41b6338ab.gif[/img]

[h2]Optimizations[/h2]

Of course we have worked on much more than this, but most of it is behind the scene stuff, so it is not so suitable to show in GIF format.

We have rewritten and optimized about 60 percent of the game though, making it run as efficient and stable as possible. So even if you build a crazy ship, performance is still stable as the following example shows:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996113/e8e22286dbf9c1b6620b465be0f5305d9dbce729.gif[/img]

[h2]Upcoming Steam Demo in May[/h2]

As we are going to exhibit Nion Forge at a convention in Leipzig on May 10th we are using this opportunity to flesh out the early parts of the game and provide our first Steam Demo. Release will probably be a week after our exhibition - so around May 17.

Thank you for reading. We promise to deliver more updates along the way. We are well on track for our demo release and our full game release in 2026.

If you have any questions about the game hit us up on our social media platforms and/or join our dedicated [url=https://discord.gg/yKRZcNMhUC]Nion Forge Discord[/url].

Until then we rely on your support and thank you for every [b]WISHLIST [/b]and [b]FOLLOW [/b]you can give on Steam and our socials!
